nodes.label: SURGE-PY-012 Preliminary Route Scoring Engine
nodes.rationale: Now a legacy/preliminary compatibility scorer: it provides spatial and constructability scoring only and does not consume the PY-015 electrical result, so it cannot by itself satisfy the canonical recommendation boundary.

nodes.label: Deterministic Min-Max Cohort Normalization
nodes.rationale: Scores are relative to the evaluated cohort: adding or removing a candidate changes every normalized score, scores from different jobs or comparison groups are mathematically incomparable, and a single-candidate cohort collapses to 0.0 regardless of weights. The exact NormalizationRange is returned alongside raw metrics so results stay auditable.

nodes.label: Hard-Violation Candidates Excluded from Normalization
nodes.rationale: Infeasible candidates are kept in the result with raw metrics and rejection reasons but excluded from cohort normalization bounds, so extreme violation quantities cannot compress the scale for feasible candidates.

nodes.label: Caller-Side Deduplication of Non-Additive Metrics
nodes.rationale: ROW footprint area, environmental overlap and parcel hits are non-additive across segments, so identity deduplication must be resolved before evaluate_network_candidates is called; the compatibility field generated_pole_record_count should be populated from the deduplicated CollectorPoleResult.total_poles.
